# Fedya Muzyka

> Personal site of Fedya Muzyka, a software engineer and builder who designs and ships web products. Currently working on Inpactive (https://inpactive.com).

All pages are static, semantic HTML — no JavaScript required to read them.

## Pages

- [About](https://fedya.ai/about): Who Fedya Muzyka is and what he does
- [Work](https://fedya.ai/work): Selected projects and products
- [Blog](https://fedya.ai/blog): Posts; feed at https://fedya.ai/rss.xml
- [Now](https://fedya.ai/now): What he's focused on right now
- [Contact](https://fedya.ai/contact): How to reach him
- [Misc](https://fedya.ai/misc): Everything else
